item.text: I’ve got the core 2022 pattern already: mediation on the grain corridor and NATO enlargement on one side, Syria/Iraq strikes and coercive bargaining on the other. I’m now filling the evidence gaps that matter for attribution, civilian-risk, and whether the conduct was defensive necessity or opportunistic escalation.
